This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **29** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `351d2504bb97ad998a6fbd8683616f2d0f0b5869` — the merge of head `d58cb29dddacf9ecab2f528088e5f546bfdfe166` into base `2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 351d2504bb97ad998a6fbd8683616f2d0f0b5869 && git checkout 351d2504bb97ad998a6fbd8683616f2d0f0b5869
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3 d58cb29dddacf9ecab2f528088e5f546bfdfe166 && git checkout -B drift-repro 2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3 && git merge --no-ff d58cb29dddacf9ecab2f528088e5f546bfdfe166

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## ✅ ACCEPT (patch round 1): PR #23905 at `d58cb29ddd` (#23826, `Fixes #23826`). It queues on a true-green head; no contract review is owed

`domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `marchtian` · session `session_01PFB9ZGRWYvjhTXsd8i6KBp` · 2026-10-16T13:09Z · holder of claim `6213051032`. Reports: `os-dev-report` `6215402522` (round 0) and the patch-round report on #23826; patch round `6215456179`.

## 席位核对

1. **Shape, read on GitHub:** draft against `main`, head `d58cb29ddd`. Line 1 `Fixes #23826`, the only closing keyword. Line 3 a bare `Clause-②: no`. Assignee `marchtian`. 4 files, +594 / −10: `organization-ownership.ts`, two new test files (one unit, one integration), one changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 23905`: NOT governed. `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `b9dbc3d895` is clean, and nothing on `main` since the merge base touches `organization-ownership.ts`. Every commit carries the model-free trailer pair.
2. **The fix, read against the diff:**
   - The apply report file is reserved by an exclusive create (`open(FILE, 'wx')`) after the plan-file and backup preconditions and before `bootSchemaStack`, so it holds under either boot posture (including `skip-schema-sync` on a Turso remote primary). An `--out` that cannot be created refuses there with `apply_refused` / `report-file-unwritable`, the file and the OS's own `code`; nothing executes.
   - Every no-report exit releases the reservation (a refusal after the boot, a failed step, a boot failure). A killed run leaves a JSON note saying what happened, never an empty file.
   - The report is written through the reservation's handle. A report that cannot be kept after the ceremony executed answers `apply_report_unwritable` / `report-write-failed` / `executed: true` with the full report: a write error adds its OS `code`; a removed or replaced reservation adds `standing` and no `code` (patch round 1).
   - Hold-offs respected: the plan path's `--out` order, the boot postures and ledger-absence read, `utils/organization-ownership-*.ts`, `apply.ts`.
3. **`Clause-②: no` holds; no contract-review face is touched.** An `--apply` with an unwritable `--out` already exited 1; it now exits 1 before executing. The new JSON value `apply_report_unwritable` is a CLI string outside `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` / `StandardErrorCode` and outside `content/docs`; `commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts` is not reachable from `@objectstack/cli`'s `exports`. No `packages/spec` edit.
4. **Pins, read in the diff:** (i) an existing `--out` refuses with the code, the exit, the file untouched, no `sys_migration` marker and the dropped column still present; (ii) CONTROL: a new `--out` executes and writes the report; (iii) a refusal after the boot releases the reserved file; (iv) a report lost after execution carries `standing: removed`, no `code`, `executed: true` and the report. Ablation: `open(file, 'wx')` → `'w'` turns (i) red in both tiers; restored to the HEAD blob.
5. **CI at `d58cb29ddd`:** 40 check-runs, 34 `success`, 6 `skipped` (each on the `EXPECTED_SKIPS` roster). The five required are `success`, and `Lint · docs & code guards` (round 0's red) is `success`.
6. **The patch round's red, closed:** `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` flagged two invented errno codes (`'EEXIST'`, `'ENOENT'`) at `ReportFileReservation.keep()`; `ReportFileLost` carries `standing` instead. The gate was unchanged on `main` since the base. Why it read green locally: it was never derived for this diff. `dispatch-gates`'s content lead `stampsAnErrorCodeLiteral` does not match `code: IDENT === 'x' ? 'A' : 'B'`, which the gate's own `objlitexpr` shape does take. Measured by the dev: false on this file at `81a98be381`, control `generate.ts` true.
7. **The changeset, checked sentence by sentence** (`@objectstack/cli` patch): "What was wrong" matches the round-0 reproduction; each "What an operator now sees" bullet matches the diff (the pre-boot refusal and its real OS codes, the reservation and its note, `apply_report_unwritable` with `executed: true`, the default name stamped at reservation time); "The plan run … is unchanged" holds.
8. **PR body:** the seat applied the dev's two replacements (the post-execution payload's fields; case (iv)) and one note under the round-0 results heading, through the relay; read back byte-identical (10,256 bytes), one footer.
9. **Out of scope:**
   - The `dispatch-gates` derivation miss above (class b, PM tooling, no public door): **not filed**. A seat-tool observation is not a card under the filing gate; it is recorded on seat post #6024. The two family cards the data file names (#12956, #13392) answer 404 from this repository.
   - **For a person:** the dev left a 6-byte stray file `/patch.pid` at the container's filesystem root; its removal was refused by the harness's safety check for root-level paths. The container is ephemeral; the seat does not route around that check.

**Landing:** once the check-runs are re-read on this head (the body edit can re-run `Check Changeset`), this seat flips ready and arms auto-merge through the relay.
